name: rule-of-thumb-model default dictionary
note: Owner M2. Every leaf is {value, source}; a source names a key of 'sources' and may add a decision id, a page or a claim-check id. 'check #N' and 'check X' name items of research/verify/*_check_v1.json; a claim not among those items is marked 'not re-checked'. Explained value by value in references/style-dictionary.md. A project changes it with <model>/style_overrides.json, never by editing this file.

sources.MAX: Max's stated preferences (spec Part 1, section 1.2): Arial; size 8 for a brick wall of data, 9 where there is white space; minimal colour; light grey column headers; row headers a lighter grey. Fixed points, not claims to check.
sources.SYNTHESIS: Research synthesis v2 (research/20261124_create_skill_ruleofthumb_financial_modeling_research_synthesis_v2.md), decisions D8 (style dictionary), D9 (number formats), D13 (sheet view), D16 (input marking), D17 (link colour), D18 (greys, density, unit band).
sources.SURVEY: Style survey of the template files on Max's PC (research ..._research_style_survey_v1.md, sections C and F, pass 2); claim checks in research/verify/style_survey_check_v1.json.
sources.R2: Researcher 2 report, section 5 (research/researcher2/research2_report_v1.md); claim checks in research/verify/researcher2_check_v1.json.
sources.FAST: FAST Standard 02c, July 2019, FAST Standard Organisation, licensed CC BY 4.0 (via research ..._platforms_standards_v1.md, section C1); claim checks in research/verify/platforms_standards_check_v1.json.
sources.ICAEW: ICAEW Financial Modelling Code (2024), summarised in research ..._platforms_standards_v1.md, section C2 (all rights reserved; not quoted); claim checks in research/verify/platforms_standards_check_v1.json.
sources.BOOKS: Book research (research ..._research_books_v1.md); claim checks in research/verify/books_check_v1.json.
sources.GUIDES: Local guides research (research ..._research_local_guides_v1.md), including Max's own files (its section C); claim checks in research/verify/local_guides_check_v1.json.
sources.PLUGIN: The plugin's own choice (design rotm_design_v1.md, or builder M2); listed for Max to decide where it matters.

dense_fill_ratio.source: SYNTHESIS D18 (builder default): a sheet the plugin did not build is dense, so size 8, when at least this share of its used block holds a value (MAX: 'a brick wall of data then 8')

dense_min_cells.source: SYNTHESIS D18 (builder default; D18: 'the body holds at least 500 cells'): and its used block holds at least this many cells, filled or empty; otherwise size 9 (MAX: 'some white spaces then 9')

sparse_sheet_cells.source: PLUGIN's own number (r4 verdict A-aera-15, reduced scope): build notes a calculation sheet that takes size 8 from its role and holds fewer populated cells than this (I-SPARSE-SHEET, information); choosing the size from measured density stays a decision for Max (SYNTHESIS D18). Measured on the v4 shipped models: calculation sheets hold 40 (starter, font_size 9 set), 98, 165, 223, 259 and 289 populated cells
